sources.snippet: The architecture of YOLO26 is guided by three core principles: Simplicity: YOLO26 is a native end-to-end model, producing predictions directly without the need for non-maximum suppression (NMS). By eliminating this post-processing step, inference becomes faster, lighter, and easier to deploy in real-world systems.
